title: Hearty Juicy Korean Nduja Gimbap
description: A Korean-inspired gimbap dish featuring nduja and bhuna, served on a hot stone plate, perfect for a brunch mood. This ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly dish combines bitter and juicy flavors.
instructions: Prepare the hot stone plate by heating it in the oven at 400 degrees for 10 minutes.
Mix the nduja and bhuna in a small bowl.
Spread a thin layer of the nduja-bhuna mixture onto a dried seaweed sheet.
Add a layer of cooked white rice on top of the nduja-bhuna mixture.
Add the pickled ginger, cucumber, carrots, and green onions on top of the rice.
Roll the gimbap tightly using a bamboo sushi mat.
Slice the gimbap into 8 equal pieces.
Serve the gimbap on the hot stone plate.
Garnish with additional green onions and pickled ginger if desired.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
